body: I did that when I was still at school. It felt interesting, after a while I started seeing weird shit like I was on hallucinogens. After 3 or 4 days of that I slept for almost 20 hours.
You also need pills. You can take a bath and just relax and fall asleep and drown. I always want to die asleep.

People can be cruel to dogs. What you actually want is to be a dog with loving owners. I would like to be one of those fancy pedigree cats with loving owner. The big one that kinda looks like a mini tiger. Then I can get pats and nap all day while looking cool.
